league_members_unseen_idx.name: league_members_unseen_idx
league_members_unseen_idx.where: "league_members"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "league_members"."result_seen_at" IS NULL

item_state_decision.name: item_state_decision
item_state_decision.value: ("item_state"."status" = 'accepted') = ("item_state"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "item_state"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

consents_account_active_uq.name: consents_account_active_uq
consents_account_active_uq.where: "consents"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "consents"."subject_account_id" IS NOT NULL

consents_seat_active_uq.name: consents_seat_active_uq
consents_seat_active_uq.where: "consents"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "consents"."subject_seat_id" IS NOT NULL

consents_seat_has_class.name: consents_seat_has_class
consents_seat_has_class.value: "consents"."subject_seat_id" IS NULL OR "consents"."subject_class_id" IS NOT NULL

accounts_nickname_not_staff.name: accounts_nickname_not_staff
accounts_nickname_not_staff.value: "accounts"."kind" <> 'staff' OR ("accounts"."nickname" IS NULL AND "accounts"."nickname_key" IS NULL)

lesson_runs_completion_fields.name: lesson_runs_completion_fields
lesson_runs_completion_fields.value: ("lesson_runs"."status" = 'completed') = ("lesson_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "lesson_runs"."completed_on" IS NOT NULL AND "lesson_runs"."completion_index" IS NOT NULL AND "lesson_runs"."summary" IS NOT NULL)

teacher_verifications_decision_pair.name: teacher_verifications_decision_pair
teacher_verifications_decision_pair.value: ("teacher_verifications"."status" = 'pending') = ("teacher_verifications"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("teacher_verifications"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("teacher_verifications"."decided_by_account_id" IS NULL)

telegram_dialogs_answered_fields.name: telegram_dialogs_answered_fields
telegram_dialogs_answered_fields.value: ("telegram_dialogs"."status" = 'answered') = ("telegram_dialogs"."choice" IS NOT NULL AND "telegram_dialogs"."item_status" IS NOT NULL AND "telegram_dialogs"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL)
